+
+rng = random.Random(72831)

+            assert result["total"] == sum(row["weight"] for row in rows)
+            for row in rows:
+                span = intervals[row["name"]]
+                assert span["finish"] - span["start"] == row["weight"]
+                assert all(intervals[parent]["finish"] <= span["start"] for parent in row["dependencies"])
+            times = {item["start"] for item in intervals.values()} | {item["finish"] for item in intervals.values()}

+                active = [item for item in intervals.values() if item["start"] <= moment < item["finish"]]

+                assert len({item["worker"] for item in active}) == len(active)
+            assert result["makespan"] == max(item["finish"] for item in intervals.values())
+            if capacity == 1:
+                assert result["makespan"] == result["total"]
+            if capacity == 32:
+                assert result["makespan"] == result["critical"]
+            executions += 1
+valid = [{"name": "a", "weight": 2, "dependencies": []}]

+    bad.append(rows)

+        pass
+    else:
+        raise AssertionError(capacity)

+from heapq import heappop, heappush
+from .model import load
+from .graph import build
+
+def simulate(rows, capacity):
+    if type(capacity) is not int or not 1 <= capacity <= 64:
+        raise ValueError("capacity must be an integer from 1 to 64")
+    plan = build(rows)
+    tasks = load(rows)
+    completed, launched = set(), set()
+    running, intervals = [], {}
+    free = set(range(capacity))
+    now = 0
+    while len(completed) != len(tasks):
+        ready = [name for name in plan["order"] if name not in launched and set(tasks[name].dependencies) <= completed]
+        for name in ready[:len(free)]:
+            worker = min(free)
+            free.remove(worker)
+            launched.add(name)
+            finish = now + tasks[name].weight
+            intervals[name] = {"start": now, "finish": finish, "worker": worker}
+            heappush(running, (finish, name, worker))
+        if not running:
+            raise ValueError("unschedulable workload")
+        now = running[0][0]
+        while running and running[0][0] == now:
+            _, name, worker = heappop(running)
+            completed.add(name)
+            free.add(worker)
+    return {**plan, "makespan": now, "intervals": intervals, "capacity": capacity}

+import json
+from parser import PREFIXES, EXAMPLES, FrameReader, fuck
+from batch import RAW_EXAMPLE, summarize
+
+def frame(kind, value):
+    return PREFIXES[kind] + value + "__"
+
+stream = frame("literal", "one") + frame("case", "two") + frame("literal", "one") + frame("case", "東京")
+expected = [("literal", "one"), ("case", "two"), ("literal", "one"), ("case", "東京")]
+assert RAW_EXAMPLE == PREFIXES["literal"]
+assert EXAMPLES == ("__SCM_LIT_unknown__", "__SCM_CASE_bad", "__scm_lit_", "__SCM_CASE__SCM_LIT_")
+split_cases = 0
+for left in range(len(stream) + 1):
+    for right in range(left, len(stream) + 1):
+        assert fuck([stream[:left], stream[left:right], stream[right:]]) == expected
+        split_cases += 1
+assert fuck(iter(stream)) == expected
+assert summarize(iter(stream)) == {"case": {"two": 1, "東京": 1}, "literal": {"one": 2}}
+assert fuck([frame("literal", "x" * 64)]) == [("literal", "x" * 64)]
+assert fuck([]) == [] and summarize([]) == {}
+bad_inputs = ["bad", frame("literal", ""), frame("case", "x" * 65), frame("literal", "line\nbreak"), PREFIXES["literal"], frame("case", "item")[:-1], frame("case", "item")[:-1] + "x"]

+    except ValueError:

+    else:
+        raise AssertionError("failure was not retained")
+    reader.reset()
+    assert reader.feed(frame("literal", "ok")) == [("literal", "ok")]
+    reader.finish()
+print(json.dumps({"split_cases": split_cases, "invalid_streams": len(bad_inputs), "frames": len(expected), "reset_after_failure": True}))

+        self.codes = sorted(set(codes))

+def compile_catalog(document, values):
+    records = document.get("templates")
+    if not isinstance(records, list) or not records:
+        raise CatalogError(["@records"])
+    ids = [record.get("id") for record in records]
+    if any(not isinstance(value, str) or not value for value in ids) or len(set(ids)) != len(ids):
+        raise CatalogError(["@id"])
+    errors = []
+    for record in records:
+        version = record.get("version")
+        if type(version) is not int or version < 1:
+            errors.append("version")
+        duration = record.get("duration")
+        if type(duration) not in (int, float) or not isfinite(duration) or not 0 <= duration <= 60:
+            errors.append("duration")
+        constraints = record.get("constraints", {})
+        roles = record.get("roles")
+        if not isinstance(roles, list) or type(constraints.get("participant_count")) is not int or len(roles) != constraints["participant_count"]:
+            errors.append("roles")
+        if constraints.get("ordered") is True and "role_order" not in record:
+            errors.append("ordered")
+        if record.get("category") not in ("calibration", "inspection"):
+            errors.append("category")
+        declared = record.get("variables")
+        try:
+            fields = {field for _, field, _, _ in Formatter().parse(record["prompt"]) if field is not None}
+            if not isinstance(declared, list) or any(not isinstance(value, str) for value in declared) or len(set(declared)) != len(declared) or set(declared) != fields:
+                errors.append("variables")
+        except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError):
+            errors.append("variables")
+        links = record.get("links")
+        if not isinstance(links, list) or any(link not in ids for link in links):
+            errors.append("@reference")
+    if errors:
+        raise CatalogError(errors)
+    result = []
+    for record in records:
+        bindings = {**values, "duration": record["duration"]}
+        missing = set(record["variables"]) - bindings.keys()
+        if missing:
+            raise CatalogError(["bindings"])
+        result.append({"id": record["id"], "text": fuck(record, bindings), "links": record["links"]})
+    return result

+import json

+bindings = {"actor_a": "Ada", "actor_b": "Lin"}
